description: Is normal technology too understandable? Have you ever wanted to perform feats that are nigh indistinguishable from magic? Do you like using technology taken from strange sources that has been turned into pure killing power by corporate giants? If so, that's kind of weird, but The Sixth Voice has you covered!
name: TheSixthVoice
summary: A partial implementation of 'The Sixth Voice' Lancer 3pp supplement by //Bela//. Created with permission. Please support the official release on itch.io!
title: The Sixth Voice
